items.description: Contains data about the certificate of deposit.

amount.description: The amount of the deposit. The value should be in dollars.

name.description: The name of the person that owns the certificate of deposit.

insurance.description: Contains data about the insurance policy.

name.description: The name of the person insured under this policy.

vehicles.description: Contains data about the vehicle(s) the insured person is permitted to drive. Each state is responsible for submitting the data it requires or supports.

policy.description: Contains information about the insurance policy.

effectiveDate.description: The date the insurance policy started.

expirationDate.description: The date the insurance policy expires.

policyNumber.description: The policy number for the insurance policy.

selfInsurer.description: Contains data about the self-insurance certificate.

amount.description: The maximum amount the self-insurance certificate is liable for. The value should be in dollars.

name.description: The name of the person the self-insurance certificate is issued to.

title.description: The business title of the person the self-insurance certificate is issued to.

schemaVersion.description: The version number of the schema
